models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light-air, near-flat pattern over the islands now; departure day is still on the edge of the forecast horizon.
briefing.synopsis: No organised gradient over the Aeolians - winds across all six islands run roughly 1.5-7 kt through 30 Sep with direction wandering between N/NE overnight-to-midday and S/SE at Portorosa in the small hours (consensus of all available models, sampled 6-hourly). Seas are decaying from about 1.2 ft at Filicudi early on 28 Sep to 0.1 ft fleet-wide by 29-30 Sep. The models only disagree meaningfully at Portorosa on 28 Sep, where the spread is 1.2-9.6 kt at 00Z and 0.4-7.0 kt at 06Z - that is a genuine range, not a mean. Guidance reaches only to 04 Oct 23:00, so the pattern beyond the first day of the trip is not covered by this payload.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: For the night of 03 Oct at Portorosa the payload shows the enclosed marina with all-round shelter, 4.8 kt SE gusting 8.7 and 0.1 ft swell - berth choice does not matter at those numbers. Nothing in the data would push the fleet to move, but that is a 5-day-out figure and will be re-run nightly. Tonight's actual berth is outside the trip window; the rehearsal run scores Portorosa Marina sheltered as well.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: This is a pre-trip outlook, not a next-morning brief - departure is five days away and only the first leg (Portorosa → Lipari, 04 Oct) is in range. As it stands the payload recommends a 06:00 departure with 6.7 kt SE, gusts 11.5 kt, 0.1 ft sea, 155 TWA - a run, and every window through 14:00 scores 'go'. Treat that as a placeholder: expect the picture for 04 Oct to change before the dock briefing.

passage_notes.note: In range: 06:00 window 6.7 kt SE, gusts 11.5, 0.1 ft, run; wind backs to NNE/NE by midday making it a close reach at ~5 kt. Verdict 'go' at all windows - likely a motor-sail if it verifies.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Panarea and all later legs
passage_notes.note: Beyond the forecast horizon (guidance ends 04 Oct 23:00). The rehearsal runs score these legs 'go' against this week's live weather, but those are dry-run scores, not forecasts for your dates.

cautions: Gust fields at these wind speeds are interval maxima from IFS and ICON-2i - 11-16 kt gusts against 2-5 kt means appear repeatedly and are an artefact of light air, not a squall signal.
Direction, not strength, is the unstable element: forecast stability at 72-120 h lead shows mean wind shifts of only 0.8 kt but mean direction shifts of 64°, so plan points of sail loosely.

Stromboli's Marina del Gabbiano scores only 'workable' in the rehearsal - open from every direction, shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm. Worth flagging early if the optional leg is on the table.
briefing.confidence_note: The models agree closely on a light, benign pattern for the next 48-72 h, but the trip dates sit at or beyond the 04 Oct 23:00 horizon and direction shifts at 72-120 h lead average 64°, so nothing here should be planned on yet.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
